Does anyone here have a Oneplus One phone? How is it?

They are hit and miss. Some love them and have no issues with them, others like myself had issues with LTE connectivity and screen touches would not always register. The issue is the supply chain that OPO uses, the hardware they acquire is not consistent. I base this on my and my buddies experience.

Having said this I will be buying the OPT (Two)

Hardware is comparable to my old S4, which is still pretty good for the price. Software is a bit of a project, but the flip side of that is great dev support from the modding community. It's a great phone if you go in expecting to tinker with Cyanogenmod a bit. Stock works just fine, but if you end up with touchscreen issues you might end up replacing a kernel with a newer build manually.

Pretty great! I've had it for.... 6 months now? I've dropped it and fallen on it and it seems to hold up pretty well. Got an official case and screen protector with it and those held up fairly well, but the plastic on the case is starting to chip now (again, I'm fairly rough with my phone) so I'm going to have to get that replaced pretty soon now.

The phone worked fantastically for the first ~4 months (est.), and then there was a OS update and it broke a lot of my phone to be perfectly honest. The latest updates seem to have fixed most of the problems with my phone (there was a keyboard bug that annoyed the fuck out of me).

EDIT: +1 (huehuehue) for battery life. It's been pretty fantastic, I tend to get a full day out of it with normal use and about half a day with really heavy use.

I have one, the battery life is incredible, it rarely ever overheats for using GPS (like my old Nexus 4 did), I haven't played any graphic intensive games on it and use it mostly for normal day-to-day stuff. And the price was really good compared to other phones with similar specs.

This is what I love most. The battery lasts FOREVER. I also really like the size of it. I don't play graphic heavy games, but it runs everything I want it to perfectly.

It also has some really nice built in features like double-tap to turn on/off, ability to choose hard or soft keys, natively adjust grid size, etc.

I also have a oneplus one. Its a good price for what you get, Comparable to an s4. I have only had issues with the WiFi connectivity. It never turns off and it has trouble connecting but its not a major problem.

I considered one. It was either going to be a Sony an LG an HTC m8 or the one plus one. The one plus one lost out because it didn't have expandable storage. Being able to have 64-128 GB of extra space is a pretty huge deal. In the end I bought an HTC m8 and I've been happy with it.

Its a solid device. Doesn't get the best speeds with Tmobile unfortunately ;/

Battery size is good, but not life changing. Next phone I get, I'm definitely gonna find one with an even larger battery or one that has swappable batteries.
